responsibility: Exercises the `SourceMap` module’s externally visible position and path-mapping behavior, validating byte/char position translation, span merging and traversal, line and snippet extraction across files and multibyte text, zero-length and end-of-file edge cases, file-path remapping, and file-loading behavior through focused regression tests and test-only helper methods.
same_name_distinction: This `tests.rs` exercises the high-level `SourceMap` API over one or more source files: byte/char position translation, span-to-lines/snippets, span merging/traversal, file loading, and path remapping. Unlike `analyze_source_file/tests.rs`, it validates the mapping layer built on analyzed source metadata rather than the raw scanning results.
